entries.final_answer: Keep watching: report the problem on stderr naming the file, record nothing, reconcile normally once the files load again. Reason: the contract says watch runs until SIGINT/SIGTERM (exit 0), so exiting 4 mid-run would contradict it; recording nothing while unloadable cannot corrupt history, and reconciling against the last recorded configuration once the files load again loses no edit (TROUPE-002).
options: Keep watching: report the problem on stderr naming the file, record nothing, reconcile normally once the files load again
Stop: exit 4 naming the file, like other commands
entries.question: While watch is running, a hand edit leaves the configuration unloadable (YAML syntax error mid-edit, include target missing, include cycle, or both troupe.yml and troupe.yaml present). What should watch do?
